}

{

  q.push(S);in[S]=1;
  while(!q.empty()){
    int u=q.front();
    in[u]=0;q.pop();
    for (int i=fir[u],v;i;i=g[i].nxt)
      if (g[i].c&&dis[v=g[i].t]>dis[u]+g[i].l){
        dis[v]=dis[u]+g[i].l;

     }

{int f,t;}s[105];

    scanf("%d%d",&s[i].f);
    scanf("%d",&s[i].t);
  }m*=2;
  for (int t=1;t<=n+k;t++){
    for (int i=1;i<=n;i++)
      adl(P(t-1,i),P(t,i),INF,0);
    for (int i=1;i<=m;i++){
      adl(P(t-1,s[i].f),P(t,s[i].t),1,D);
      pl[t][i]=tl;st[t][i]=1;
    }adl(P(t,1),T,INF,t*C);
  }

    int u=T;
